spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact Stage-4 static Iterator.zip with an iterable of iterables (the decided calling convention) and covers the decided zero-sources edge (already-completed iterator).

interactive.rationale: Three editable lists and a run button drive the real call; the result panel prints the engine's actual rows or actual TypeError.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a real-call playground including the zero-sources case; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Empty inputs drop sources down to zero; numeric coercion of tokens; honest error path.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992 plus the proposal, repo, and champion demo.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts both statics, positional tupling, zero-sources, all three modes, and keyed output — matching the three concept pages.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: real call produced the genuine 'TypeError: Iterator.zip is not a function'; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for native-ran and honest-unsupported branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; error output in accent-rose on paper (AA); ≥44px inputs.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled inputs, aria-live result panel, native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column stack with wrapping output; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify native rows on a V8 that stages joint-iteration
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141's V8 lacks the statics even behind harmony flags. Re-run on Chrome 153 with chrome://flags/#enable-javascript-harmony and confirm real tuple rows including the zero-sources empty result.

guidanceConsulted.query: multiple list inputs drive computed result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every input and keep the run affordance explicit.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Three labelled fields; native run button; aria-live result.

guidanceConsulted.query: single column playground long output wrapping
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap long JSON output inside bordered panels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result uses pre-wrap + break-all; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): honest TypeError path confirmed on Chromium 141 with clean console at both viewports; success-path rendering of the sibling dashboard was additionally exercised via a harness-injected test shim (not shipped in any page).
